integrity.result_scope: A complete analytic proof and exact local-deviation obstruction; accompanying exact-rational finite tests supplement but do not replace it.
integrity.unproved_limits: No result on strategyproofness of the cubic mechanism for more than three agents.

scientific_limitations: The positive strategyproofness classification covers exactly three agents and two report-site facilities, not all population sizes.
The sharp exponent-three welfare ratio follows from a previously derived general power-law approximation formula and is not itself new.
Only unilateral strategyproofness in expectation is established, not group strategyproofness or optimality among other mechanisms.
Equivalent unindexed analyses may exist; self-review does not establish independent priority.
title: The cubic truthfulness threshold for three-site inverse-power facility omission
